items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: And Fred Astaire made a recording of that with Benny Goodman’s band on Columbia Records.

ctx.x: It doesn’t sound familiar to me.

George Gershwin wrote that song “Who Cares.” And Fred Astaire made a recording of that with Benny Goodman’s band on Columbia Records. Great, great record, where he sang, and then he tap danced, and Benny Goodman’s sextet at that time with Lionel Hampton and Charlie Christian played the background for him, when he gave him a stop tempo like this Monk [Sol plays]. Then the band would come in. Oh, pick up that record if you can, will ya? And on the other side is another great song that Fred Astaire sang, and he…
